pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 5.Nc3 Bb4 6.Bd2
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed a3-b4 onto the b4-bishop; plan 4 had White recapture Bxc3 before Black had captured. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 5.Nc3 d5
pages.notes: Plan 2 gave White's cxd5 inside a Black plan; plan 3 called the c-file semi-open with White's pawn on c4. Rewrote plans 2-3. Reviewer rejection (after cxd5 the c-file is fully open, Black having no c-pawn) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 5.Nc3 Nc6 6.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 3 had Black play ...g5 with White's bishop on g5. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 5.Nc3 Nc6 6.e3
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote castling as 0-0 and cxd5 before ...d5. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 5.Nc3 Nc6 6.g3 Bb4
pages.notes: Plan 1 named Bxc3 bxc3 as White's moves. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 5.Nc3 Nc6 6.Ndb5 Bb4
pages.notes: Plan 1 said a3 means doubled pawns via bxc3, but the b5-knight recaptures. Rewrote plans 1 and 4 around 7.a3 Bxc3+ 8.Nxc3 and the isolated d-pawn; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 5.Nc3 Nc6 6.Ndb5 d5
pages.notes: Plan 3 read e5 as a White move. Rewrote plan 3 around 7.Bf4 and the queenless main line; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Two Knights, 5.Nc3 Nc6 6.Ndb5 d5 Queenswap
pages.notes: Plan 1 called Black's c6-pawn White's passed pawn; plan 3 pushed a White c-pawn that does not exist; overview missed that the b5-knight is attacked. Rewrote overview and all four plans.

pages.name: English Opening: Symmetrical Variation, Rubinstein Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 proposed a Hedgehog against an early d4, which does not fit the ...Nc7/...e5 set-up. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 2...g6
pages.notes: Plan 2 read d4 as a Black move; plan 4 gave the Botvinnik set-up as e4, d3 and f4. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.
